characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike poiss Juku tumepruunide lühikeste juustega, seljas roheline kootud kampsun (green knitted sweater, not a jacket) ja jalas sinised püksid, sõbralik ja rõõmsameelne ilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ANNI
characters.description: Üks väike tüdruk Anni kahe blondi patsiga (blonde pigtails), seljas punane kampsun ja jalas kollased püksid, uudishimulikud silmad ja rõõmus naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Laste tuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light blue walls, light wooden floor, single large window on back wall showing raindrops falling outside, soft round woven rug in the middle of the room, plain walls with warm light streaming inside. Simple cartoon style.

pages.scene: Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Raindrops fall visible outside the window. Juku, a small boy in a green sweater and blue pants, and Anni, a small girl with blonde pigtails in a red sweater, stand near the window looking outside with gentle smiles. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Juku and Anni sit together on the soft round woven rug in the center of the room. A wooden box full of colorful large toy blocks (red, yellow, blue, green) sits on the floor between them. Rain is visible outside the window. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Juku and Anni sit on the round rug and begin stacking colorful wooden blocks on the floor. Juku carefully places a block on top of a small base. Anni reaches into the wooden block box smiling excitedly. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Juku carefully places a bright red wooden block onto a small tower of four colorful blocks on the round rug. Anni sits beside him on the floor, holding a yellow block and watching intently with a happy smile. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Anni carefully adds a bright yellow block onto the growing colorful block tower on the round rug. Juku kneels next to her, watching happily with wide excited eyes. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Juku kneels upright on the round rug to reach higher and adds a green block to the top of the tall tower of colorful painted toy blocks (red, yellow, blue, green). Anni sits on the floor looking up at the high tower with wide eyes and joy. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Anni reaches up carefully to place a triangle-shaped blue roof block on top of the tall colorful tower on the round rug. Juku stands beside her watching happily with raised hands. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. A tall, beautiful, finished block tower crowned with a triangular blue roof stands sturdy in the middle of the round rug. Juku and Anni stand next to it admiring their tower with big proud smiles. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.

Inside the cozy playroom with light blue walls and wooden floor. Juku and Anni are happily clapping with open hands while standing beside their tall finished tower on the soft round rug. The tower is a single stack of brightly painted toy blocks (red, yellow, blue, green, purple) with a blue triangle roof block on top, the same tower as on the previous page, not plain unpainted wood. Both children are laughing with bright joyful expressions. Juku has short dark brown hair and wears a green knitted sweater and blue pants. Anni has two blonde pigtails and wears a red sweater and yellow pants. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.
